I added `Money.apply_rate(rate: Decimal) -> Money` in `ledger/money.py`. The four existing tests still pass. I didn't add a test for the new method, but I spot-checked it by hand.

It multiplies the amount by `rate` in exact `Decimal` arithmetic and rounds to the nearest cent. Exact halves round away from zero, so 10.05 × 0.5 gives 5.03 and −0.05 × 0.5 gives −0.03.

Your request didn't say which rounding rule to use and the codebase has none, so I chose half-up, the usual convention for currency. If you'd rather have banker's rounding, change `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `apply_rate`.
